483-2228-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
483-2228-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
483-2228-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

3510-3875-4875-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
3510-3875-4875-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

232-574-678.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
232-574-678.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

730-1479-2841-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
730-1479-2841-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-2842-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2146-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Repeat

1739-4399-4518-7818.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Herald's Horn.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1739-4399-4518-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-5662-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Reyhan enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2459-3652-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-3652-6108-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1008-1619-4605-5542-5686.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-4605-5542-5686.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-4605-5542-5686.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

876-5709-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
876-5709-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Rofellos.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Rofellos.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Rofellos.
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Rofellos.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Rofellos.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Rofellos from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3197-4506-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4506-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5686-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5686-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5686-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

891-1258-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

240-3967-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

628-5686-7213.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

4871-5220-5651-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5651-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2762-4321-4659.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a Food and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4681-5147-5170-6559.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3532-5060-5078-5240.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled by Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6664-6965.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-6664-6965.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1978-2750-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
1978-2750-5704.description:
Cause Leafkin Avenger to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat from step 2.

3464-3657-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with power 4 or greater.
3464-3657-5704.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3464-3657-5704.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

2921-3951-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2921-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

997-3817-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
997-3817-5170.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 2.
Repeat.

647-1069-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
647-1069-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

1069-1322-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1322-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

1170-1636-6058.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1170-1636-6058.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Conviction by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Conviction spell.
Activate Conviction by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-4231-4321-5270-5682.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Astrid, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

2011-3598-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One has a power of five or greater.
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2011-3598-4871.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate five Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawns die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers five times, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Rapacious One has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

678-793-3581.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Scorched Rusalka, adding {R}.
Scorched Rusalka dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Scorched Rusalka from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scorched Rusalka by paying {R}.
Repeat.

338-1656-4762-5162.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Necrotic Ooze.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
338-1656-4762-5162.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Kwain's ability by tapping it, allowing each player to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Necrotic Ooze triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
